Track down the fanatics and bring peace back to the world.

I rescued the pitiful protagonist of the game…
only to somehow end up taking his place.

“Daddy! Call me Daddy, Master!”

“As long as I have you, I don’t care if the world burns.”

122205.synopsis:
When Lin Ran woke up, she found herself transmigrated into a wasteland novel from a pink website, becoming one of the many “dog-lickers” (simps) for the female lead, Mo Shuyu.
However, Mo Shuyu only used her. Due to an accident, the base Mo Shuyu was in completely fell, so she took her child to seek refuge with Lin Ran. Lin Ran originally thought her happiness was coming, but she didn’t know that Mo Shuyu already had a relationship with the person in charge of her previous base and had him quickly eliminate Lin Ran.
During a concentrated zombie culling operation, Lin Ran was “accidentally” shot dead by her own people. Until her death, Lin Ran was still thinking, “If I’m gone, who will protect Mo Shuyu and the child?”
Lin Ran looked at the contents of the book with a head full of question marks. “It’s the apocalypse, and she’s still acting like a simp? Serves her right to die early.”
Anyway, she wouldn’t follow the original plot. What did Mo Shuyu’s life or death have to do with her? Stockpiling supplies and improving skills were far more important.
Lin Ran didn’t think much about the female lead’s affairs, spending every day busy buying, buying, buying.
When the apocalypse arrived, Lin Ran sometimes stayed at home eating and drinking, and sometimes went out to kill zombies, exchanging them for randomly drawn cards to save her life. Her days were busy and fulfilling.
However, she saw that the mother and daughter living across the door were quite pitiful, and she often gave them some food. The little one would always thank her with sparkling eyes. Just as she was gradually getting familiar with the woman and the child, Lin Ran learned that the woman was Mo Shuyu. Her attitude towards Mo Shuyu and her daughter immediately took a sharp turn for the worse.
But the child was just too cute, looking at her with teary eyes. Looking behind the child, Mo Shuyu was also looking at her with red eyes. Lin Ran admitted, she really couldn’t resist anymore. “Simp, then simp. Can’t I be one?”

130397.synopsis:
The outskirts of a city surrounded by layers of walls, District 28. Using the sewers, Isaac painstakingly infiltrates the city—specifically, District 28. Unfortunately, he comes face-to-face with the newly appointed chief of security.
The chief of security, Samuel, the most dangerous entity in the city, the Party’s trained hound, a butcher.
“…An angel?”
However, the moment Isaac first sees him in his pristine white uniform, he mistakes him for an angel from old tales. Of course, it was only a fleeting misconception. Chief of Security Samuel was undeniably a white demon clad in human skin, a warden of hell itself.
“Shall I let you live?”

135517.synopsis:
Inside the Terra Federation, on a game livestream:
“Let me check out the latest sensation, the hottest game sweeping Terra. Can’t believe the streamer hasn’t tried it yet.”
“Nuclear leak? Sounds interesting. What’s it called… Chernobyl?”
“From the looks of it, it’s a storyline about some kind of energy plant explosion? The streamer seems to be in some team, maybe the fire department? The gear looks kinda bulky—probably on some mission?”
“Soviet Federation, huh? Interesting, the plot’s pretty solid.”
A few days later, on the game forum:
“How do you deal with a nuclear leak getting into the groundwater?”
“The story says only 3 Roentgen. I had gear rated for 5000 Roentgen—why did it break the moment I stepped in?”
“Come on, Strategy Team, do your thing!”
“The Strategy Team almost solved the groundwater problem just now, but then the nuclear reactor had a second explosion. They passed out on the spot!”
Dozens of days later, the Strategy Team finally beat Chernobyl.
Just as everyone stopped worrying about clearing Chernobyl, two new titles hit the market: Fukushima and Return to Chernobyl.
“Guys! Is that new DLC?!”
“Let me see. Oh, this time it’s… Fukushima. The name sounds more optimistic, like ‘blessings as vast as the Eastern Sea.’”
“And it’s actually in the eastern sea?”
Private Marseille—
“What do you mean, only ten people?”
“What do you mean, it’s worse than Chernobyl?”
“What do you mean, the top brass committed seppuku and the lower ranks are told to figure it out themselves?”
“H*ll! Strategy Team!!”
BOOM—
Right before their eyes, the nuclear reactor exploded again.

137053.synopsis:
In a car accident, Pei Ji travels seven years into the future. He looks up and sees that his hospital room is bigger than his own home, with countless medical staff revolving around him alone.
Pei Ji: “Did I strike it rich?”
His friend who came to visit sneers: “You latched onto a sugar daddy, but you’ve almost messed it all up.”
L-Latched onto a sugar daddy?!
He was just blacklisted by his company yesterday for refusing unspoken rules—how could he possibly do something so spineless???
Pei Ji is utterly confused. After inquiring around, he learns a few more shocking pieces of news.
The sugar daddy he latched onto is the aloof and untouchable music god Chu Tinghan. The two of them had a passionate underground romance for two years, loving each other to death, but now they’re about to break up.
Pei Ji’s brain crashes: “Why are we breaking up?”
His friend glances at him sideways: “Because you said you were tired of playing.”
What the hell? Tired of playing?
After being discharged, Pei Ji looks at Chu Tinghan’s ads plastered all over the streets and his sold-out concerts for tens of thousands, falling into deep thought.
It’s not that he got tired of playing—he must have gotten tired of living, right?
How could he possibly afford to mess with someone like that!
***
Pei Ji still can’t accept that his future self would turn into a freeloading s*umbag.
He takes the initiative to find Chu Tinghan, intending to admit the mistake on behalf of his future self, but Chu Tinghan refuses to see him at all.
Chu Tinghan’s assistant curses him out, saying he’s not even human—if he never intended to take the relationship seriously, why did he go and create a child?
Pei Ji: There’s a child too???
Upon further inquiry, he learns that he and Chu Tinghan’s child is already two years old.
And rumor has it that Chu Tinghan has been retching nonstop lately, as if there’s another bun in the oven.
Pei Ji: …My future self really isn’t human.
Pei Ji recalls his own miserable childhood without parental love, and his sympathy and fatherly instincts overflow.
Even if they’ve broken up, the child is innocent.
The next day, Pei Ji finally sees Chu Tinghan and says he wants to live a good life with him.
Chu Tinghan stares at him for a long time, then smiles faintly. “Sure, but first, let’s get the certificate—we’re getting married.”
Those clear eyes don’t resemble the current Pei Ji; instead, they look like the spirited young idol from a few years ago.
He slipped up last time and didn’t catch him—maybe this time, he can try pursuing him again?
***
Half a year later, Pei Ji finally meets his and Chu Tinghan’s two-year-old child.
The child is covered in fluffy white fur, with a little tail wagging happily behind, excitedly circling around him.
Pei Ji points at the Samoyed in disbelief: “You’re saying this is our child?”
Why does it feel like he got tricked…

192861.synopsis:
Fake Goddess Exposed? No. No Romance Harem. Awesome Female Lead. Everyone Loves Her.
Yun Shu transmigrated with a dress-up system into a chaotic era novel.
It was the end of the Yong Dynasty. Natural disasters were frequent. The land was full of starving people.
She put on the system’s starter outfit, Snow-White Scent of Fragrance, which came with the Infinite White Porridge skill.
The system told her to win over the male lead, Shen Jue. But she decided to pretend to be a goddess.
With her amazing acting skills, she stunned everyone from the start. Refugees rushed to become her followers and built a Goddess Temple for her.
On day one, when Shen Jue heard that a goddess had come down to earth to give out porridge, he laughed. He thought she was just a charlatan trying to fool the people.
On day two, when he saw that the refugees around him were all drinking white porridge, Shen Jue’s eyes went wide. He was being chased and could only gnaw on tree bark.
On day three, Shen Jue knelt every three steps. He bowed every nine steps. With pure sincerity, he begged the Goddess to come forward for the sake of the suffering world.
Later.
When there was no harvest, the Goddess waved her hand. She gave out divine seeds. Every family had extra food. There was no more starvation.
When a plague spread, the Goddess held a magical herb. She guided the people and taught them a holy book to heal the sick.
When a great drought came, the Goddess pitied the people. She wore a feathered robe. On a high platform, she danced a breathtaking dance. She called down a heavy rain.
From then on, the world was peaceful. People had enough clothes and food. They lived stable lives. The Goddess’s name spread far and wide. Followers filled every land.
The system watched its host. Not only had she maxed out the male lead’s affection. She also maxed out the affection of the entire world.
“Is this right?”
Yun Shu smiled. “Basic skills. Don’t be impressed.”
